failure_signature: A generated Python helper passes syntax compilation but fails when an exercised reporting or checksum path references a module or name that was never imported.
known_resolution: Add the missing import or runtime dependency.
Validate any already-written output before retrying mutation.
Run a focused executable self-test covering reporting and checksum paths.
preflight_detection: Execute a negative fixture whose reporting path references an unimported module and require the validator to reject it.
Fail helper delivery when any declared terminal path has not executed successfully.
preventive_control: Require generated helpers to expose and pass a runtime self-test before delivery.
Run py_compile plus the declared self-test; neither alone is sufficient.
Verify the delivered helper digest before invocation.
root_cause: Syntax compilation validates parsing and bytecode generation but does not execute late runtime paths or resolve referenced global names.
symptoms: The helper performs useful work and then raises NameError.
Checksum or terminal reporting fails after output files exist.
Repeated helpers fail on the same missing runtime import.
title: Execute generated Python helper runtime paths before delivery
